tagline: A Khmer-inspired Minecraft Survival Multiplayer world
welcomeMessage: Welcome to AngkorSMP! Build among the ruins, survive the jungle, and write your own chapter of the empire.

serverFeatures.title: Chill Community
serverFeatures.desc: A relaxed, friendly SMP — no drama, just building and surviving together.

serverFeatures.title: No Raiding
serverFeatures.desc: Bases and builds are protected. Griefing and raiding other players is not allowed.

serverFeatures.title: PvP Your Way
serverFeatures.desc: Toggle PvP on or off anytime — play how you want, fight who wants to fight back.

serverFeatures.title: Live Cambodia Map
serverFeatures.desc: Explore the world in real time.
